transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm... well, I'm having some trouble at work. I'm a nurse, and lately, I just... I lose my train of thought constantly on the floor. It's like, if an IV pump beeps, or I hear someone asking another nurse a question, or a call light goes off... I just suddenly forget what patient flow issue I was even working on. It's becoming a problem.
Have you experienced any recent changes or stressors at work or in your personal life that might be contributing to these difficulties?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... work is always work, but there haven't been any big changes or anything. Everything is just... the same as usual, I guess.
Do you ever feel sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort, like your heart is racing, you're short of breath, or you feel like you're losing control?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really get anything like that.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things in your life, like work, family, or other responsibilities, even when there isn't a clear problem?
No, not really. I mean, I worry sometimes like anyone else, but... it's not constant. Just normal stuff, I think.
Have you noticed any days recently where you feel down, sad, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy?
No... I don't think so. My mood is mostly fine, I guess. I haven't really felt sad or anything like that.
Outside of work, do you find it hard to stay focused on tasks or conversations, or do you often feel easily distracted by things around you?

Um... maybe a little at home. But... mostly it's at work. That's really why I made the appointment. When I'm on the floor... I just lose my train of thought constantly. Like, if an IV pump beeps, or a call light goes off, or... even if someone just asks another nurse a question nearby... I'll suddenly completely forget what patient flow issue I was working on.
When you say it’s mostly at work, does that mean you don’t have the same problem staying focused at home or during other activities?
I mean... I guess I just don't notice it as much at home. It's quieter. I don't know, it's just... work is where it's a real problem.
When you're at home or in other non-work environments, do you find yourself getting distracted easily by sounds or things happening around you, even if it's not as busy as work?
Um... I don't really know. I guess maybe sometimes... if the TV is on or something. But mostly I just... I don't really notice it being an issue at home.
Have you ever found yourself struggling to finish tasks at home, even small ones like reading a book or following a recipe, because your mind wanders or you get sidetracked easily?
I don't... I don't really read much anymore. And I usually just make simple things for dinner. So... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it.
When you're in a quiet place, like at home, do you still find it hard to focus on what you're doing, or do you feel like your mind jumps around a lot even when there aren't many distractions?
I guess... maybe sometimes my mind jumps around. But... I don't really know. It's just hard to say.
When you're in a quiet place, like at home, do you find it hard to focus on tasks like reading, watching TV, or having a conversation, even when there aren't many distractions around?
I don't think so. Um... like I said, I don't really read. And watching TV is usually fine, I guess. I just... I haven't really noticed it being hard.
Looking back, did you have any trouble focusing or staying on task when you were a child, like in school or during other activities?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, my mom kept all my old report cards from elementary school. The teachers always wrote the same thing... that I was smart but careless. I was always losing my worksheets or... just forgetting to turn in my homework. My mom actually had to sit with me every single night just to make sure I did it. So... yeah, I guess it was a problem back then too.

Outside of work and childhood school settings, do you find it hard to focus or stay organized in other parts of your life, like managing bills, keeping track of appointments, or following through with plans?

Um... yeah, I suppose. I just... I forget things that should be routine. Like... paying a bill at home, or calling a family member back. I'll fully mean to do it, but... it just doesn't happen. Or I'll miss an appointment, or forget to check on a missing order... even if I actually set a reminder for myself. It's just... yeah.

latest_inference.note: The patient reported difficulties with attention and focus dating back to childhood, as well as ongoing issues with forgetfulness, losing items, and problems with task completion even outside of work. These symptoms are consistent with ADHD, predominantly inattentive presentation. Symptoms are not limited to anxiety or mood disturbances, which were denied. Symptom duration and pervasiveness support F90.0 over other candidates.
